title: 有馬記念の後に・羨望と

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City suffers a loss to Tamamo Cross. Cheers admiring Tamamo Cross's strength resound throughout the stands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It fills Gold City with envy and despondency. No one seems to discuss her accomplishments, convincing her that no matter how much she runs, her skill will never be recognized.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross is angered by Gold City's gutless performance and asks her why she runs in the first place, but Gold City can't find an answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she talks to me, she quietly concedes that nothing she does will ever change her reputation. But when asked if she would stop running, she does nothing to affirm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unconvinced that she truly wants to give up, I decide to register her for the Osaka Hai, with my eyes now set on the Senior Spring Triple Crown.
